content.text: Found a real bug: training sources with zero contexts must be included (they block all clauses). Let me fix it.

cd /app/submission && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('main.py').read()

# 1) record all training sources (including traces without contexts)
old = """        sources = []
        for tr in train_traces:
            if tr["source"] not in sources:
                sources.append(tr["source"])
        require(len(sources) <= 16)
"""
new = """        sources = []
        for tr in train_traces:
            if tr["source"] not in sources:
                sources.append(tr["source"])
        require(len(sources) <= 16)
        self.train_sources = sources
"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new, 1)

# 2) build per-source masks over every training source (zero-context sources included)
old = """        src_masks = {}
        for index, ctx in enumerate(self.train_ctx):
            src_masks[ctx[1]] = src_masks.get(ctx[1], 0) | (1 << index)
        n_sources = len(src_masks)"""
new = """        src_masks = {name: 0 for name in self.train_sources}
        for index, ctx in enumerate(self.train_ctx):
            src_masks[ctx[1]] = src_masks.get(ctx[1], 0) | (1 << index)
        n_sources = len(src_masks)"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new, 1)

# 3) initialise the attribute
old = """        self.max_width = 1
        self.min_support = 1
        self.min_witness = 1"""
new = """        self.max_width = 1
        self.min_support = 1
        self.min_witness = 1
        self.train_sources = []"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new, 1)
open('main.py','w').write(src)
